latency.primary_speed_claim: Full system is 2.96x faster than baseline by median latency (9.8975s vs 29.2823s). Excluding 2 outlier(s): 2.8x.

user_satisfaction.note: Respondents are the 4 development team members. External user study required before generalised satisfaction claims.

learning_outcomes.note: n=2 (preliminary). USER-71cbf510 posttest manually recorded (6/6 correct, laptop shut down before API capture).

limitations_paragraphs.title: Inter-Rater Reliability
limitations_paragraphs.text: Inter-rater reliability was low (Pearson r=-0.0467). Quadratic-weighted Cohen kappa by dimension (min-disagreement reconstruction): correctness=0.727 (substantial), pedagogical_clarity=0.222 (fair), appropriateness=0.200 (fair). Per-rater win rates (100%/50%) are reported separately. Rubric calibration and >= 3 raters recommended for future work.

limitations_paragraphs.title: Ablation Latency Caching Artifact
limitations_paragraphs.text: Fixed config run order with shared embedding cache artificially deflates full_system latency. All configs show ~10-16s; ordering unreliable. Randomized rerun needed.

limitations_paragraphs.title: Ablation Primary Metric Alignment
limitations_paragraphs.text: Scaffolding accuracy (originally reported) is identical across all configs since the Decision Engine is untouched. Corrected per-component metrics derived from existing data.

limitations_paragraphs.title: Underpowered Learning Outcome Study
limitations_paragraphs.text: Learning gain n=2 (preliminary). KHIZ-001: pre=82%, post=79%, raw=-0.03, Hake=-0.1667. USER-71cbf510: pre=16.67%, post=100%, raw=+0.8333, Hake=+1.0 (posttest manually recorded after session interruption). Mean Hake gain=+0.4167. Insufficient n for validated conclusions.

limitations_paragraphs.title: Baseline Latency Non-Normality
limitations_paragraphs.text: Baseline std (74.5937s) > mean (65.6098s). 2 outlier run(s) above 100s. Median reported as primary speed metric.
